patch_description: This version replaces the many-order greedy construction with a bounded beam-search bin packer. For each binary-searched KVPR target, it transforms models into target-dependent effective sizes and keeps multiple promising partial placements instead of committing to one greedy decision. The beam balances real KVPR while also favoring compact effective-memory packing, which reduces fragmentation and finds lower-pressure layouts more reliably. A final move/swap descent further improves the best beam solution.
